components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The limestone action used for the preferred reading path.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--limestone); border-radius: 0; background: var(--limestone); color: var(--ground); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 180ms var(--ease), color 180ms var(--ease), border-color 180ms var(--ease); } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: var(--cyan); background: var(--cyan); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--magenta); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The transparent companion action for alternate routes.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--cyan); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 180ms var(--ease), color 180ms var(--ease), border-color 180ms var(--ease); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--cyan); background: rgb(83 199 238 / 8%); color: var(--bright); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--magenta); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Icon Control
components.description: A square terminal control for search, menu, and close actions.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-control" type="button" aria-label="Search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6"></circle><path d="m16 16 4 4"></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-control { display: grid; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 8px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--cyan); cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-control svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-icon-control:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); color: var(--bright); } .ds-icon-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--magenta); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Filter Field
components.description: The underlined mono search field used to filter packages and coordinates.
components.html: <label class="ds-filter-label" for="ds-filter">FILTER <input class="ds-filter-field" id="ds-filter" type="search" placeholder="auth…"></label>
components.css: .ds-filter-label { color: var(--faint); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-filter-field { width: 130px; margin-left: 8px; padding: 7px 8px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--bright); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; outline: 0; } .ds-filter-field:focus { border-color: var(--magenta); } .ds-filter-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--magenta); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Uppercase terminal links with a cyan survey-line current state.
components.html: HOMEGUIDESPACKAGES
components.css: .ds-primary-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -8px; left: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--cyan); content: ""; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 220ms var(--ease); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-link[aria-current] { color: var(--bright); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after, .ds-nav-link[aria-current]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--magenta); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Code Slab
components.description: A square Aegean code field with an inset copy control.
components.css: .ds-code-slab { position: relative; margin: 0; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ground); color: var(--bright); } .ds-code { display: block; min-width: max-content; padding: 22px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.75; } .ds-copy-code { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: var(--field); color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-copy-code:hover { border-color: var(--cyan); color: var(--bright); } .ds-copy-code:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--magenta); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Field Route
components.description: A flat route card divided from its neighbors by survey rules.
components.html: QUICK STARTBuild a working route from the field guide.
components.css: .ds-field-route { display: flex; min-height: 172px; padding: 26px; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: background 180ms var(--ease); } .ds-field-route strong { color: var(--cyan); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field-route span { color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--body); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-field-route:hover { background: rgb(83 199 238 / 6%); } .ds-field-route:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--magenta); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Constellation Node
components.description: The luminous package link that gives the system its reusable signature.
components.css: .ds-star-node { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--cyan); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 160ms var(--ease), filter 180ms var(--ease); } .ds-star-node span { width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 1px solid var(--bright); background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgb(83 199 238 / 54%); transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-star-node:hover, .ds-star-node:focus-visible { color: var(--bright); filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 12px rgb(83 199 238 / 20%)); } .ds-star-node:hover span, .ds-star-node:focus-visible span { border-color: var(--magenta); background: var(--magenta); } .ds-star-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--magenta); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Atlas inhabits a midnight Aegean observatory terminal: deep navy fields hold limestone type, cyan survey lines, and sparse magenta registration marks. The interface is dense but not cramped, with the discipline of a field dossier and the legibility of a technical reference. Condensed display type supplies the monumental scale; readable humanist text and monospaced labels keep the system useful beside an editor.

Greek mythology appears through naming, measured geometry, the Atlas line figure, temple-like divisions, and the package constellation. The 1980s layer comes from restrained CRT bloom, terminal labels, and chromatic instrument marks. The system rejects faux-vaporwave kitsch, generic purple gradients, ornamental controls, and raster-heavy delivery.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight navy fields separated by thin cyan survey rules.
Limestone display and reading type with cyan technical labels.
Square terminal controls and disciplined one-pixel construction.
Magenta used only for registration, focus, and exceptional state.
The package constellation as the reusable signature pattern.

rules.name: The Instrument Marks Rule
rules.body: Ionian cyan carries structure and action; registration magenta marks focus, selection, and exception. Neither becomes a broad decorative fill.

rules.name: The Night Field Rule
rules.body: Keep the Aegean ground dominant and build hierarchy with the two field tones before introducing glow or shadow.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Display type names the terrain, body type explains it, and mono type operates it. Do not use condensed display type for paragraphs or body type for terminal state.

rules.name: The Field-First Depth Rule
rules.body: Establish separation with field tone and one-pixel rules; reserve shadow for the modal plane and glow for luminous instrument marks.

rules.name: The Instrument Geometry Rule
rules.body: Keep functional surfaces square; use circles and diamonds only when they communicate coordinates, nodes, or celestial measurement.

dos: Do preserve the deep field hierarchy before reaching for shadow.
Do use limestone for readable text and cyan for technical structure and action.
Do keep controls square, compact, keyboard-visible, and divided by one-pixel survey rules.
Do use the constellation, Atlas figure, and Greek geometry as structural signatures.
Do disable orbital motion and state transitions when reduced motion is requested.
donts: Don't turn the palette into a generic purple gradient or broad neon wash.
Don't use magenta as a general surface color; it is a registration and exception mark.
Don't add soft rounded cards, ornamental controls, or decorative dashboard shells.
Don't set long-form documentation in the condensed display face or mono label face.
Don't rasterize interface text, diagrams, or package navigation.
